item.title: Trump Hints At Prosecuting Obama For Leaking Classified Information
item.description: Trump said Obama made a big mistake and leaked classified information when the former president suggested that he believes aliens are real, but Obama, unlike Trump, didn't leak anything.

item.title: A Sweaty And Babbling Trump Tried To Deliver An Economic Speech In Georgia And It Was A Disaster
item.description: Trump went to Rome, GA to deliver a supposed speech on the economy, but what happened was a sweaty and rambling president buried himself and the Republican Party under his babble.

item.title: Trump Totally Lost It After The Supreme Court Gutted His Tariffs
item.description: Every policy and tariff expert outside of MAGA expected the Supreme Court to overturn Trump's tariffs, but when the president heard about it, he became enraged and began cursing and ranting.

item.title: Trump Is Going Insane After Losing Tariffs Case And Winning The Midterm For Democrats
item.description: Trump announced that he will be increasing the global tariff he imposed yesterday to 15%, which means that the president responded to his SCOTUS loss by raising prices on the American people.

item.title: Trump Has Made Canada Hate The United States
item.description: Trump has turned Canada against the United States to the point where Canadians view the US as a bigger threat than Russia.

item.title: Did Trump Call Into C-SPAN As John Barron To Trash The Supreme Court's Tariff Ruling?
item.description: Some on social media think the C-SPAN caller who said his name was John Barron was really Trump trashing the SCOTUS tariff ruling, so let's compare the voices.

item.title: Donald Trump Humiliates Himself On Iran
item.description: Donald Trump has backed off of his threat of a large air attack against Iran, and is instead considering a targeted strike to serve as a warning that the regime must leave power.

item.title: Trump Sets A Stunning Second Term Disapproval Record Before The State Of The Union
item.description: Trump will head into the first State Of The Union of his second term as the least popular second term president of this century.

item.title: Senate Democrats Sink Trump By Announcing They Will Block Any Extension Of His Tariffs
item.description: Senate Democrats announced that there will be no extension of Trump's Section 122 tariffs, as they will block any effort to go beyond the 150 day limit.

item.title: Dozens Of Democrats Are Not Going To Trump's SOTU
item.description: House and Senate Democratic leadership have told Democrats that they can attend the SOTU or they can go do something else. Dozens of Democrats are choosing something else.
